title: The Soviets Drilled the Deepest Hole Ever
gist: The excerpted opening of a Nautilus piece recounts how a 1980s evangelical TV program, Trinity Broadcasting Network's Praise the Lord, told millions of viewers that a real Soviet deep-drilling project had accidentally tunneled into Hell.

themes.theme: A Cold War urban legend on evangelical TV

insights.claim: In the late 1980s, some cable TV programming claimed the Soviet Union had literally dug straight to Hell, not as Cold War rhetorical hyperbole but as a literal assertion.
insights.speaker: Charles Digges
insights.so_what: Sets up a real historical case study in how a scientific project got mythologized into supernatural folklore during the Cold War.
insights.quote: In the late 1980s, from certain corners of cable TV, you could learn that the Soviet Union had dug straight to Hell. Not in the metaphorical, Reagan-Era, “look what those commies have done” sense of the word. No. They had literally dug straight to Hades.

insights.claim: The claim that Soviet drillers had tunneled into Satan's underworld ran on Trinity Broadcasting Network's long-running program Praise the Lord, which reached around 5 million daily viewers.
insights.speaker: Charles Digges
insights.so_what: Quantifies the reach of the program that spread this claim, showing how a real Soviet drilling project could become the basis of a mass-audience supernatural story.
insights.quote: The story ran on a program called Praise the Lord, the long-running worship and current events program aired by the evangelical Trinity Broadcasting Network, which reached around 5 million daily viewers.

insights.claim: The program explored, over several episodes, how a real Soviet deep-drilling project had allegedly accidentally tunneled into Satan's underworld.
insights.speaker: Charles Digges
insights.so_what: Illustrates how an actual scientific drilling program (implicitly the Kola Superdeep Borehole) became the seed for a widely broadcast supernatural claim.
insights.quote: Over several episodes, the program explored how a Soviet deep drilling project had accidentally tunneled into Satan’s underworld.
